title: Learning to Deceive with Attention-Based Explanations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. Its focus is on the manipulability of attention mechanisms, using gender bias and other non-religious predictive features as case studies.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the manipulability of attention mechanisms, primarily using gender bias as a case study.
